fact_types.title: Voluntary federal income tax withheld in box 6 of one logical Form SSA-1099 statement instance furnished to the taxpayer or spouse for 2025; same statement/tax-year identity as box 5 net benefits on the same statement, but a separate fact and a separate family. Nonnegative source amount only. Not the box-6 absent-or-zero witness tax.us.2025.ssa1099.box6-withholding that earlier packages require.
Affirmative closure of the Form SSA-1099 box-6 withholding family at the current membership horizon.

label: Form SSA-1099 box-6 voluntary federal income tax withheld for tax year 2025
